items.title: What can you do with a DAX query? | Zoe Douglas
items.location: Online
items.summary: **What can you do with a DAX query? \| Zoe Douglas** Power BI has a query language to get data out of the semantic model -- the DAX query. This is different from DAX formulas you find in calculated columns, tables, and measures. With DAX query view you can quickly use this to understand your data, try out new formulas, and troubleshoot formulas you already have. If you were ever curious about what a DAX query was or want to know more, come and find out! **Zoe Douglas, Product Manager at Microsoft** I am a product manager for Power BI at Microsoft. I focus on unlocking awesome features for visuals and dedicated to helping all customers get the most out of their data!

items.title: AI for DevOps & SRE: From Impressive Demos to Operational Trust
items.location: Online
items.summary: AI for DevOps & SRE: From Impressive Demos to Operational Trust What would make you trust an AI agent with operational changes? An agent can generate a valid command and still misunderstand the objective. It can mistake missing telemetry for a healthy service, or choose an action outside the scope you authorized. How do we recognize these failures before they affect real systems? Join Bucharest XDevOps Meetup for a practical, vendor-neutral session exploring the risks of AI-assisted operations and the controls that help manage them. We’ll work through three synthetic scenarios in isolated environments: 1. The command is valid, but the objective is wrong. 2. The query returns no data, but the…
